name: scheduler_runs
title: Scheduler Runs
description: Run history for daemon-scheduled tasks -- one append-only row per execution, written best-effort by object_daemon.process_scheduler. The Flower lesson: a run's outcome must be a RECORD an operator can query, not a stdout line only ssh can reach (q9's auto-approve sat dead for years and this server's own scheduler pass sat disabled because run outcomes were invisible). result carries the target's return value (JSON, truncated); error/error_type carry the failure. Admin-read only (permissions/rules.json); the /scheduler page renders this plus the live task board from the scheduler trigger's state.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.help: The target object's return value as JSON, truncated to 2000 chars.
